hakone-skyline-and-fuji-lakes.title: Hakone Skyline and Fuji Lakes
hakone-skyline-and-fuji-lakes.slogan: A 209 km loop out of Odawara coast
hakone-skyline-and-fuji-lakes.story: Tokyo escape with mountain air and Fuji discipline. A 209 km loop that starts and ends near Odawara, about 4 h 01 of riding. On the way it passes Lake Ashi, Gotemba  window and Lake Yamanaka Fuji view. Hakone Turnpike high road is the high point. It tops out at about 900 m. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
